title: Milestone 2: Service and Errors
prompt: Build a typed validation boundary: ValidationError(TaskError) and service functions add_task(repo, title: str) -> int (strip title; empty/whitespace or non-str raises ValidationError; then delegates to repo.add) and complete_task(repo, task_id: int) -> bool (non-int raises ValidationError; missing id raises NotFoundError(TaskError)). Annotations must be readable via typing.get_type_hints.

tests.name: valid path delegates

conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')

from sqlite3 import connect

tests.name: blank title raises ValidationError
tests.hint: Empty, whitespace, non-str → ValidationError before touching repo.

tests.name: stripped title passed through
tests.code:
calls = []
class Repo:
    def add(self, t):
        calls.append(t)
        return 7
assert add_task(Repo(), '  real work  ') == 7
assert calls == ['real work']

tests.name: complete validates and translates
annotations are present
tests.code:
import typing
hints = typing.get_type_hints(add_task)
assert hints.get('title') is str and hints.get('return') is int
hints2 = typing.get_type_hints(complete_task)
